messages:

Subject: Acme_OrderForm_v3 - SLA redlines + evidence ask

Hi Hannah,

Thanks for sending the updated order form. Attached are our redlines to the MSA + Order Form focusing on SLA terms — uptime target, service credits, response times, and maintenance window restrictions. High level asks from Acme:

- Baseline uptime at 99.95% (we ran numbers vs availability impact on customer SLAs)
- Service credit formula that scales to 10% of monthly fees for sustained incidents (we need clearer stacking rules)
- P1 response time of 30 minutes and P2 acknowledged within 2 hours
- Maintenance windows limited to 4 hours/month and no maintenance allowed in our peak window (Mon-Fri 13:00-18:00 ET)

Also, our legal team is asking for SOC2 Type II evidence and a runbook excerpt showing incident detection and RCA timelines before procurement can sign. Please review our attached PDF of redlines (Acme_OrderForm_v3_redlines.pdf) and let me know your team's position.

We can set up a 30-min call tomorrow if helpful. Procurement would like to close this week if possible.

Best,
Sarah

Subject: Fw: Acme_OrderForm_v3 - SLA redlines + evidence ask

Team — forwarding Acme's redlines. Quick internal sync points I want before we draft a reply:

1) Uptime: Acme asks for 99.95%. Our standard hosted SLA is 99.9%. For Dedicated we can offer 99.95% at +20% commit. Propose we push for 99.9 baseline and offer a paid upgrade path to 99.95 (order form option).

2) Credits: Acme wants up to 10% monthly fees stacked. Ops/legal prefers a capped model to avoid runaway liability. Proposed compromise: tiered credit matrix up to 8% for multi-day outages, with a combined monthly cap of 12% for repeated failures (see SLA_Comparison_Table.xlsx attached).

3) Response times: P1 30m is aggressive for global infra. We can commit to 1 hour for P1 response (ack and triage) with a four-hour mitigation target and P2 at 4 hours. Offer a 30-minute SLA as an add-on with a higher support tier.

4) Maintenance: We should avoid hard blocks but can contractually exclude Acme's stated peak window and limit regular maintenance to a single 4-hour weekly window plus quarterly patch windows. Need product input on blackout enforcement and how to schedule rolling maintenance across regions.

5) Evidence: We can provide SOC 2 Type II report and a sanitized incident runbook excerpt. Ops can produce an evidence packet; legal will redact.

Next steps: Aditya, can you review the uptime/credits math and confirm the Dedicated 99.95 pricing delta? Rachel, can you coordinate the SOC2 artifact and prepare a redacted runbook sample. Lauren, I need legal wording to propose the capped credit matrix and the paid 99.95 option. I’ll draft a reply to Acme by EOD tomorrow.

- Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Acme_OrderForm_v3 - SLA redlines + evidence ask

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear redlines and the timeline. We reviewed this with Ops and Legal and have a proposed compromise below (high level) — attaching a counter-redline PDF (Redwood_SLA_counter_redlines.pdf).

Proposed compromise (summary):
- Uptime: Baseline hosted SLA at 99.9%. Offer a contract option to upgrade to 99.95% (applies to dedicated pools or higher commit) for an additional fee; we will call this the "Premium Availability Addendum."
- Credits: Tiered credit matrix (month-over-month): 0.5% for 99.7–99.9, 2% for 99.0–99.7, 8% for <99.0. Combined monthly cap at 12% of monthly recurring fees; single incident credit cannot exceed 8%. Stacking rules and remediation timelines included in the counter-redline.
- Response times: P1 acknowledgement within 1 hour (incident triage and customer-facing update). Target mitigation ETA 4 hours. P2 acknowledged within 4 hours. We can offer reduced acknowledgement windows (P1 30 min) as a support-tier add-on.
- Maintenance windows: We will exclude Acme's peak window (Mon–Fri 13:00–18:00 ET) from routine maintenance scheduling. Regular maintenance will be limited to a configurable 4-hour maintenance window per week plus one quarterly 6-hour patch window; emergency maintenance exceptions described in counter-redline.
- Evidence: We'll provide SOC2 Type II report and a redacted incident runbook excerpt. Ops will bundle the evidence packet and an operations contact for on-call escalations.

Next steps:
1) Legal review on your side of the counter-redline (attached link to DocuSign for convenience) — https://app.docusign.com/ACME-SLA-2025
2) Ops will assemble evidence and runbook by EOD Wed (we’ll share via Drive)
3) If helpful, let's schedule a 30-min call Thu to walk through the credit math and the Premium Availability pricing. Please indicate availability and whether Acme's legal prefers tracked redlines or a marked-up final PDF.
